text: {"overall_winner":"A","qualities":[{"evidence":"three body paragraphs with topic sentences","quality":"organization","description":"It presents its reasons in a clearer multi-paragraph structure that makes the argument easier to follow."},{"evidence":"“First… Secondly… Also… Lastly…”","quality":"transitions","description":"It uses explicit signposting to move through points in a more controlled, coherent way."},{"evidence":"references to safety, benefits, environment, and law","quality":"development","description":"It develops several distinct concerns with supporting discussion instead of staying at a single general claim."},{"evidence":"quotation from the article and repeated article references","quality":"textual support","description":"It grounds the argument more in the source text by pointing to specific details from the article."},{"evidence":"“I would want to oppose the development”","quality":"clear stance","description":"It states a more definite position on the issue and returns to that position in the conclusion."}]}
